Summary: 10 requirements reviewed: 4 with issues, 6 without. 4 issues found (3 Medium, 1 Low). Types: Vague_Language (1), Incomplete_Requirement (2), Untestable_Requirement (1).

RequirementReviews.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The system shall send an order confirmation email to the customer within 60 seconds of a successful payment.
REQ-002: The system shall apply free shipping to all orders with a subtotal of $50 or more.
REQ-003: The checkout page shall load quickly and support a large number of shoppers.
REQ-004: Managers and finance staff who have completed security training shall be able to approve refunds.
REQ-005: Payment transaction records shall be retained for audit purposes.
REQ-006: Customers shall be able to cancel an order at any time before it is dispatched.
REQ-007: Customers shall not be able to cancel an order once payment has been confirmed.
REQ-008: The order service shall never reject a valid order.
REQ-009: The product search shall return results within 1.5 seconds for 98% of searches under 2,000 concurrent shoppers.
REQ-010: Customer payment card numbers shall be stored in encrypted form.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: The checkout page shall load quickly and support a large number of shoppers.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The terms 'quickly' and 'large number' have no objective interpretation, so the requirement cannot be verified.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Replace 'quickly' with a specific load time target and 'large number' with a defined shopper count.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: Customers shall be able to cancel an order at any time before it is dispatched.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not define when an order is dispatched, so the cancellation window cannot be implemented consistently.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the exact condition that triggers an order as dispatched.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: Customers shall not be able to cancel an order once payment has been confirmed.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not define when payment is confirmed, so the cancellation restriction cannot be implemented consistently.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the exact condition that constitutes payment confirmation.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: The order service shall never reject a valid order.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: An absolute guarantee of no rejections with no bounded measurement period or allowed exceptions cannot be objectively verified.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: State a bounded rejection rate target with a defined measurement period.
